title.en: Postponing the Date for Filing Certificate of Candidacy for Sectoral Representatives to the Interim Batasang Pambansa and Prescribing Rules to Govern Multiple Candidacies

text.en:
Postponing the date of filing of certificates of candidacy for sectoral representatives. The
provisions of Presidential Decree No. 1296, otherwise known as the 1978 Election Code notwithstanding, the
certification of candidacy for sectoral representative to the interim Batasang Pambansa shall be filed not later

Multiple filing of certificate of candidacy not allowed. Any person who filed a certificate of
candidacy for regional representative shall not be eligible to file another certificate of candidacy for sectoral
representative: Provided, that such person may withdraw his certificate of candidacy for regional
representative at such time as to enable him to file within the period herein provided a certificate of candidacy
for sectoral representatives; Provided, however, That if there be a person who, before the effectivity of this
decree, filed certificates of candidacy for both regional and sectoral representatives, such person shall, in a
sworn statement to the Commission filed before March 7, 1978, indicate what certificate of candidacy he
wants to continue and canceling the other, otherwise, failing to do so, both certificates shall be null and void.

Withdrawal or cancellation of certificate of candidacy. No certificate of candidacy duly filed
shall be considered withdrawn or canceled unless the candidate files with the official which received the
certificate of candidacy or with the Commission, as sworn statement of withdrawal or cancellation.

Effectivity. This decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 14th day of February, in the year of Our Lord nineteen hundred and
seventy-eight.
